name: Throg
description: Fan-made hero pack by Patatasaurio & Caurel: Throg / Puddlegulper, 15 hero cards around the Frogjolnir upgrade, the Between Two Worlds obligation and a 5-card nemesis set (Thanos, An Unexpected Guest, the Power Stone, Inevitable Power x2).

permission.evidence: Granted in the Marvel Champions homebrew channel on Discord; confirmed by the project owner (Quin Carter) on 2026-11-13. The curated repository's record: https://github.com/bluefireF5ran/mc-digital-custom-packs/blob/a51e50da556ece0b0fe9a75848320416b8794cef/throg_ptt/mod.json
permission.scope: inclusion and translation: the Spanish edition and the English translation by Francisco Merchán are covered (owner, 2026-11-13)
permission.note: 2026-11-13 is the date the owner confirmed the grant, not the date of the Discord message.
